# Mapped Array

Source: [4742](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4742); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Mapped Array](../../api/values/mapped-array.md).

<a id="wiki-4742-n1"></a>

- Mapped Array evaluates a mapping for each element and returns a copy; assign it back to update the original stored array.

Source limitations:

- Array parameter description erroneously says copy will be sorted; mapping behavior is clear from prose/example.
